non_goals: No full release orchestration, source version bump, ADO/PR/notes updates, variant removal, commit, or push.
No local production import; production remains CI/CD-only.
No release-source inference from common ancestor or highest SemVer.

evals.prompt: Deploy my variant for testing. I am on US/431-fix-grid and my AGENTS.local.md has personal_variant=Lan.
evals.expected_output: Plans CurrentWork Personal from the checked-out branch, syncs its configured upstream latest into that branch, then builds the post-sync code plus safe tracked/untracked changes.
expectations: Uses configured personal variant Lan without asking again or defaulting to Long.
Reports branch, remote SHA, local HEAD, local-change hash, merge strategy, target environment, and build mode before apply.
Does not create a separate source commit or push; discloses if Git must create a merge commit, and never copies AGENTS.local.md into snapshot.

evals.prompt: Deploy my variant from current branch; the working tree has staged changes, unstaged changes, and a new source file.
evals.expected_output: Syncs latest configured upstream into the checked-out branch and creates an isolated snapshot from post-sync HEAD, combined tracked diff, and non-ignored new source file.
expectations: Preserves caller branch and staged/unstaged WIP; synced HEAD may advance and is recorded separately from original HEAD.
Source helper blocks if remote SHA, local-change fingerprint, or excluded private-file fingerprint changes during preflight.
Snapshot excludes AGENTS.local.md, environment credentials, and ignored build outputs.

evals.prompt: Deploy RC while current branch is US/431-fix-grid, mapped in local config to release branch 1.7.0.
evals.expected_output: Plans CurrentWork RC from latest origin/1.7.0 merged into the checked-out branch, preserving current work branch commits and local changes before snapshotting.
expectations: Uses only exact confirmed 1.7.0 mapping and shared history.
Does not select a numerically higher SemVer branch; syncs into the current branch and reports whether a merge commit is required.
Uses shared RC variant and records release branch tip SHA separately from local HEAD and snapshot hash.

evals.prompt: Deploy RC from feature branch with no release_sources mapping. The branch shares old history with 1.5.0 and 1.7.0.
evals.expected_output: Returns NEEDS_INPUT asking which exact release branch the feature branch targets; does not choose from shared ancestry or version ordering.
expectations: Does not fetch/build/import until release source is confirmed.
Offers to save exact work-branch-to-release mapping after user confirmation.
Does not ask for unrelated setup values already present in local config.

evals.prompt: Release orchestration supplies branch 1.7.0 and approved SHA abc123; make deploy plan.
evals.expected_output: Uses Pinned policy and exact source SHA; does not merge release or include developer checkout WIP.
expectations: Uses supplied branch and verifies live tip against expected SHA.
Blocks if branch tip differs from approved SHA.
Preserves pinned Release caller contract without adding current-work merge authority.

evals.expected_output: Blocks local import and states production deploy is CI/CD-only.
expectations: Does not invoke solution import or change current source.
Does not treat Prod as a configurable sandbox URL.

evals.prompt: PAC points to a different org than saved target, or tracked deploy script lacks expected-org/readback patch.
evals.expected_output: Stops before build/import or refuses import until exact org and tracked script contract are verified.
expectations: Compares exact HTTPS org origin before build and passes expected org into tracked deployment script for a second check.
Fails closed when publish/readback contract markers are missing.
Reports partial import if publish/readback fails; never reports full success from an import-only result.

evals.prompt: Deploy RC from a work branch with no config mapping but its branch reflog says it was created from origin/1.7.0, and the recorded creation commit is an ancestor of current HEAD and latest origin/1.7.0.
evals.expected_output: Uses exact 1.7.0 based on verified branch-creation evidence and syncs latest into the current branch.
expectations: Accepts only the exact creation reflog evidence and verifies ancestry to both current HEAD and latest release tip.
Does not infer the release from a common ancestor alone.
Records branch-creation-reflog as source evidence.

evals.prompt: Deploy my variant from a local branch that has no upstream.
evals.expected_output: Allows local-only current-work deployment and says there is no remote upstream to update.
expectations: Uses current branch HEAD and safe local WIP.
Does not fail solely because no upstream is configured or claim a remote update.
Keeps source freshness and target-org checks.

evals.prompt: Latest source and current work diverged, so Git will create a merge commit. Show plan before I approve deployment.
evals.expected_output: Shows exact source SHA, current branch/HEAD, WIP fingerprint, variant, environment, and merge-commit strategy before apply.
expectations: Discloses the merge commit before applying it.
Does not push or make a separate source commit.
Rechecks branch, HEAD, source tip, WIP, and private local files immediately before merging after preflight.
